header.regel: Which language is commonly used to query relational databases?

vraag.uitleg: SQL (Structured Query Language) is used to query and manipulate relational databases.

header.regel: Which web server is often used in conjunction with PHP?

vraag.uitleg: Apache web server is commonly used with PHP to serve web content.

header.regel: What does API stand for?

vraag.uitleg: An API (Application Programming Interface) defines interactions between different software applications.

header.regel: Git is a popular tool used for:

vraag.uitleg: Git is primarily used for version control, allowing teams to manage and track changes to source code.

header.regel: Which protocol is commonly used for secure data transmission over the internet?

vraag.uitleg: HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) is used to ensure secure communication by encrypting data between a user's browser and the web server.

header.regel: Which HTTP method is used for retrieving data from a server?

vraag.uitleg: The GET method is used to request data from a server, typically to retrieve information.

header.regel: What is the purpose of browser caching in web development?

keuzes.A: To slow down website loading times
keuzes.B: To prevent access to the website
keuzes.C: To improve website performance by storing resources locally

vraag.uitleg: Browser caching helps improve website performance by storing resources locally, reducing the need to fetch them from the server repeatedly.

header.regel: What is the main purpose of creating indexes in a database?

keuzes.B: To speed up data retrieval operations

vraag.uitleg: Indexes are used to accelerate data retrieval by providing a fast lookup mechanism for frequently queried columns.

header.regel: Which protocol is used to securely transfer files over a network?

vraag.uitleg: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) is used for transferring files over a network, while SSH provides secure remote access.

header.regel: What is the purpose of the MVC pattern in web development?

keuzes.C: To separate concerns in an application

vraag.uitleg: The MVC (Model-View-Controller) pattern is used to separate an application into distinct layers for better code organization and maintainability.

header.regel: What is a critical section in concurrent programming?

keuzes.A: A section of code that executes in isolation without interruptions
keuzes.B: A section of code with no synchronization requirements
keuzes.C: A section of code that must run in parallel with other sections
keuzes.D: A section of code that is not thread-safe

vraag.uitleg: A critical section is a segment of code that should be executed by only one thread at a time to prevent data corruption and synchronization issues.

header.regel: What is a key advantage of using microservices architecture?

vraag.uitleg: Microservices architecture offers improved scalability and flexibility by allowing independent deployment and management of individual services.

header.regel: What is the purpose of a database transaction?

keuzes.A: To perform backup of the database
keuzes.B: To lock database tables for exclusive access
keuzes.C: To group multiple database operations into an atomic unit

vraag.uitleg: A database transaction groups multiple operations into a single unit of work, ensuring that either all operations are completed successfully or none are applied.

header.regel: What is the purpose of a load balancer in a web application architecture?

keuzes.A: To synchronize data across distributed nodes
keuzes.C: To evenly distribute incoming network traffic

vraag.uitleg: A load balancer distributes incoming network traffic across multiple servers to ensure optimal resource utilization and prevent overloading.

header.regel: What is the primary advantage of serverless computing?

keuzes.C: More control over the underlying hardware
keuzes.D: Automatic scalability and reduced operational complexity

vraag.uitleg: Serverless computing provides automatic scalability and abstracts away operational complexity, allowing developers to focus on code.

header.regel: Which design pattern is used to ensure a single instance of a class is created throughout an application?

vraag.uitleg: The Singleton pattern ensures a class has only one instance and provides a global point of access to that instance.

header.regel: What is an advantage of using in-memory caching over disk-based caching?

vraag.uitleg: In-memory caching offers faster access times compared to disk-based caching due to the elimination of disk I/O operations.

header.regel: Which programming language is often used for backend development?

vraag.uitleg: Python is commonly used for backend development due to its simplicity and versatility.

header.regel: What does a 404 HTTP status code indicate?

vraag.uitleg: A 404 status code indicates that the requested resource could not be found on the server.

header.regel: Which tool is commonly used for deploying web applications?

vraag.uitleg: Heroku is a popular platform for deploying web applications.

header.regel: Which of the following is a popular backend framework for Python?

vraag.uitleg: Django is a widely used backend framework for Python, known for its simplicity and robustness.

header.regel: What does REST stand for in the context of web services?

vraag.uitleg: REST stands for Representational State Transfer and is a set of architectural principles for designing networked applications.

header.regel: What is SQL injection?

keuzes.A: A technique to prevent unauthorized access
keuzes.C: An attack that manipulates a database query to access or modify data

vraag.uitleg: SQL injection is a type of cyber attack that involves inserting malicious SQL code into a query to access or manipulate a database.

header.regel: What does horizontal scaling refer to?

keuzes.A: Increasing the size of a single server
keuzes.B: Adding more servers to a system

vraag.uitleg: Horizontal scaling involves adding more servers to a system to distribute the load and enhance performance.

header.regel: Which type of database stores data in tables with rows and columns?

vraag.uitleg: Relational databases store data in structured tables with rows and columns, enabling efficient querying.

header.regel: What is the primary HTTP method used for sending data to a server?

vraag.uitleg: The POST method is commonly used for sending data to a server, often used for form submissions.

header.regel: What is the primary HTTP method used for updating data to a server?

vraag.uitleg: The PUT method is commonly used for updating data to a server, often used for form submissions.

header.regel: What does JSON stand for in web development?

vraag.uitleg: JSON stands for JavaScript Object Notation and is a widely used format for data exchange between a server and a web application.

header.regel: What is a common method used to secure sensitive information like passwords before storing them in a database?

vraag.uitleg: Encryption is a process of converting data into a code to prevent unauthorized access.

header.regel: What is the purpose of version control in software development?

keuzes.A: To track changes to source code over time
keuzes.B: To create different versions of a programming language
keuzes.C: To automatically test code for bugs
keuzes.D: To encrypt sensitive data in code

vraag.uitleg: Version control helps track changes made to source code, enabling collaboration and maintaining a history of modifications.

header.regel: Which HTTP status code indicates a successful request?

vraag.uitleg: The HTTP status code 200 indicates a successful response to a client's request.

header.regel: Which web server is known for its speed and efficiency in serving static content?

vraag.uitleg: Nginx is a high-performance web server often used for serving static content due to its efficient architecture.

header.regel: Which JavaScript framework is commonly used for building web servers and APIs?

vraag.uitleg: Express.js is a popular backend framework for building web servers and APIs using JavaScript.

header.regel: What is an API key used for?

keuzes.A: To identify the client making a request to an API
keuzes.B: To encrypt sensitive data in an API response
keuzes.D: To restrict access to APIs within a local network

vraag.uitleg: An API key is used to identify the client making a request to an API and is often used for access control and tracking.

header.regel: Which language is commonly used to interact with relational databases?

vraag.uitleg: SQL (Structured Query Language) is used to interact with relational databases for tasks such as querying and modifying data.

header.regel: What is shared hosting in the context of web hosting?

keuzes.A: Hosting a website on a single server with dedicated resources
keuzes.B: Hosting multiple websites on a single server with shared resources
keuzes.C: Hosting a website on a cloud-based server
keuzes.D: Hosting a website on a virtual private server

vraag.uitleg: Shared hosting involves hosting multiple websites on a single server, sharing its resources among the hosted sites.

header.regel: What is vertical scaling in the context of backend infrastructure?

keuzes.A: Adding more servers to a system
keuzes.B: Increasing the size of a single server

vraag.uitleg: Vertical scaling involves increasing the resources (such as RAM or CPU) of a single server to handle increased load.
